scope: Proposition 5.3 of the manuscript “A power improvement in the Heilbronn triangle lower bound” (preprints/A-power-improvement-in-the-Heilbronn-triangle-lower-bound-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 191 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e43687a84b82e23f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the distribution in (5.4), with s = |S| ≥ 1, the following bounds hold with absolute constants: W(A) ≪ 1 if the columns of A mod q are affinely independent, W(A) ≪ q3 /s if rank(A mod q) ≥ 2, W(A) ≪ (q3 /s)2 for every A. (5.7) If W(A) > 0, no column of A mod q is zero, and its columns are either affinely independent or include two equal columns. For an affinely independent triple with W(A) > 0, there is no nonzero x ∈ Z3 with |x| ≤ H and Ax = 0 mod q.
